description: Configuration keywords for FLAC plot item types created via 'plot item create <type>'. Item types and their keyword sets are binary-validated against FLAC2D 9.0 and FLAC3D 9.7 (see per-file validation notes).

items.name: zone
items.description: Continuum zone visualization. Use 'contour <attribute>' for scalar/vector field maps, 'label <type>' for categorical labeling (group/state/model/property), and 'color <Color>' for flat coloring.
items.common_use: Visualize continuum grid results: stress, displacement, pore pressure, temperature, model state, groups.

items.name: gridpoint-fix
items.description: Gridpoint fix-condition markers (velocity, pore-pressure, temperature fixity).
items.common_use: Show where boundary fixities are applied. For gridpoint field values (displacement, velocity, pp, temperature) use 'plot item create zone contour <attribute>' instead — zone contour interpolates from gridpoint data.

items.name: structure
items.description: Structural-element visualization. Types: structure-beam, structure-cable, structure-liner, structure-pile (beam-family — share keyword set), structure-vector (vector field at nodes).
items.common_use: Visualize structural-element groups, forces/moments/axial via 'contour <attribute>', categorical via 'label <type>'.

items.name: chart-history
items.description: History time-series line chart: bind traces with 'history <name>', plot vs step or cross-plot vs another history
items.common_use: Plot recorded histories over cycling: convergence ratio, zone/gridpoint/structure quantities

items.name: flac3d-items
items.description: FLAC3D 9.7 verified keyword sets for the 3D item types not covered by the FLAC2D-validated files: zone-vector, zone-tensor, zone-face, zone-isosurface, zone-profile, zone-boundary, zone-water, zone-interface, zone-attach, zone-joint, zone-track, zone-stereonet, struct-node-fix, structure-shell, structure-vector, chart-table, fos, history-locations, axes, scalebox, plus the beam-family keyword set.
items.common_use: Look up 3D-only plot item types and the 2D/3D keyword differences.

shared_keywords.description: Top-level keywords accepted by most FLAC plot item types (validated against FLAC2D 9.0). FLAC3D 9.7 additionally accepts clip, cut and transparency on most items, and drops the 2D-only color/show-zone-id/text/zone-id-max/zone-id-min from the zone item.

notes: Plot-item keywords are appended after the item type.
Some compound settings are easier to apply with 'plot item modify <id> ...' after creating the item.
Probe the binary live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to see the full keyword set for any type, and 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' to drill into a keyword.
FLAC3D 9.7 item types are covered in flac3d-items.json. The unified 9.x kernel enumerates every engine's item types in 'plot item create ?'; acceptance does not imply the item renders FLAC data.

'plot delete' takes NO plot name (deleting the current plot); use "plot '<name>' delete" to target one. A name passed to 'plot delete' is reported as an unused extra parameter AFTER the current plot has already been deleted. Verified FLAC3D 9.7.
